title: guzmania undulatobracteata

This epiphytic plant has been found to have potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
